title: 952. Vowel Spellchecker

examples.explanation: Exact hits win first ('kite', 'KiTe', 'Hare'); case-insensitive matches resolve 'Kite' and 'HARE'; vowel-tolerant matches catch 'keti' and 'keto'.
No exact hit exists, but lowercasing both sides matches 'yellow'.
'hallo' shares the consonant skeleton of 'hello', while 'xyz' matches nothing and yields an empty string.

hints: Build the exact set plus lowercase-first and vowel-masked-first maps in a single pass.
Keep the first vocabulary word for each masked key; later duplicates must not overwrite it.
Lowercase before masking so uppercase vowels collapse to the same wildcard.
